title: Egyptian priests levitating blocks with sound

tellings.quote: of ancient Egyptian Traditions that speak of the priests levitating these large blocks and this is accompanied by sound

plain: Ancient Egyptian traditions are said to describe priests lifting the huge stone blocks of the pyramids into the air, with the help of sound. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels about these traditions without naming a specific text. If true, it would mean the builders had some technique since lost.
